master: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: square project icon for Herdr Lazyagent, a native developer-tool mod that monitors AI coding-agent usage limits. Create a polished original, minimal emblem combining a calm stylized sheep head (Herdr) with one simple semicircular usage-meter arc above its forehead (lazyagent limits). The sheep has a compact cloud-like wool outline, two small ears, a charcoal slate face and two minimal relaxed eyes; the muted cool blue gauge has a single short needle and no ticks or numerals. Integrate the sheep and gauge into one immediately recognizable, balanced silhouette, not two separate symbols. Style: clean flat geometric app icon, crisp edges, generously rounded shapes, restrained detail, excellent legibility at 32 pixels. Light-surface variant: dark charcoal slate and muted cool blue, with small light neutral face details as needed. Composition: centered on a square 1024x1024 canvas, generous uniform clear margin around the complete mark, occupying roughly 75% of canvas. Background MUST be actual alpha transparency, including all empty space around the mark, no checkerboard baked into image. No tile, no rounded-square container, no text, no letters, no watermark, no drop shadow, no background glow, no gradients. This is the single master design that later variants must preserve.

variants.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: the attached square Herdr Lazyagent sheep-and-gauge icon. Preserve the exact sheep design, sleeping eyes, wool lobes, ears, muzzle, blue semicircular gauge and needle direction, scale, square canvas and centered placement. Refine it into the final TRANSPARENT variant for LIGHT surfaces: add a thin but clearly visible charcoal-slate contour around the outer pale wool silhouette, keep the face charcoal and the gauge cool muted blue. Clean every outer edge and remove all isolated flecks, speckles, detached tiny pixels and fringe outside the single clean connected silhouette. Background must be genuine zero-alpha transparent, not black or a checkerboard. Keep the white wool and charcoal face solid and fully opaque, with clean antialiased edges only. No text, no tile, no shadows, no extra symbols. Same mark and dimensions as the reference.

Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: attached Herdr Lazyagent sheep and gauge mark. Produce the TRANSPARENT variant optimized for DARK surfaces. Preserve exactly the silhouette, wool lobes, face, ears, relaxed eyes, muzzle, blue gauge shape and needle, all positions and proportions, scale and square canvas. Change ONLY contrast treatment: replace the thin charcoal outer outline with a thin pale cool gray edge continuous with the off-white wool, so the whole outer silhouette reads cleanly on charcoal surfaces; brighten the blue arc slightly for dark backgrounds. Keep the face and gauge needle charcoal and the eyes and muzzle white. Preserve the same icon identity. Background MUST be real alpha transparency everywhere outside the single clean mark. No flecks, detached pixels, black backdrop, checkerboard, shadows, tile, text or new shapes. Solid opaque mark interiors, clean antialiased edge only.

Use case: compositing. Edit target: attached Herdr Lazyagent sheep and gauge mark. Produce the LIGHT BACKGROUND square icon. Preserve the exact silhouette, wool lobes, face, ears, relaxed eyes, muzzle, blue gauge and needle, all positions and proportions, scale and square canvas size. Change only the background: place this exact outlined dark-face mark on a solid flat very light warm-neutral background #F6F7FA that covers the entire square canvas, fully opaque, including the corners. No rounded-square tile inside it, no shadows, no new text, no extra shapes. Keep the complete dark contour and crisp antialiased edges. This must look like the reference mark simply composited onto a light surface.

Use case: compositing. Edit target: attached Herdr Lazyagent sheep-and-gauge mark. Produce the DARK BACKGROUND square project icon. Preserve exactly the sheep silhouette, wool lobes, charcoal face, ears, relaxed white eyes and muzzle, bright cool blue gauge arc and needle, proportions, centered placement and scale. Place the exact mark onto a completely solid flat charcoal background #171C24, fully opaque across the entire square canvas including corners. Keep the pale gray outer contour from the reference so the white wool silhouette reads crisply. Clean the edge into a smooth continuous contour, removing all outer flecks, pixel debris, white protrusions and any detached speckles. No glow, gradients, drop shadow, text, rounded-square tile or new elements. The result should look like the reference simply composited onto a dark surface with clean edges.
